tools.name: Word to PDF
tools.title: Word to PDF Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Convert a .docx file into a PDF, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn a Word document into a PDF that looks the same everywhere it's opened — done locally in your browser, nothing uploaded.

faqs.q: Is my document uploaded to convert it?
faqs.a: No. The conversion reads your .docx file and builds the PDF entirely in your browser using mammoth.js and pdf-lib — nothing is sent to a server.

faqs.q: Will formatting be preserved exactly?
faqs.a: This is a basic, text-focused converter: it lays out the extracted text as a PDF. Complex formatting, images, and page layout from the original .docx are not preserved.

faqs.q: Do I need Microsoft Word installed?
faqs.a: No. Everything runs in the browser tab — no Word, no other software required.

tools.name: PDF to JPG
tools.title: PDF to JPG Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Convert every page of a PDF into a JPG image, free and browser-based. Download all pages as a ZIP.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn every page of a PDF into its own JPG image — useful for sharing a page as a picture, or pulling a document into a slide deck.

faqs.q: Do I get one image per page?
faqs.a: Yes. Every page is rendered as a separate JPG image, bundled together into a ZIP file for download.

faqs.q: Is the PDF uploaded to convert it?
faqs.a: No. Pages are rendered to images locally in your browser using pdf.js — nothing leaves your device.

faqs.q: What resolution are the JPGs?
faqs.a: Pages render at a resolution suited for on-screen viewing and sharing — not designed for large-format printing.

tools.name: JPG to PDF
tools.title: JPG to PDF Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Combine one or more images into a single PDF file, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn one or more photos or scans into a single PDF — the order you add them is the order they appear in the document.

faqs.q: Can I combine multiple images into one PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. Add as many images as you like and they're combined into one PDF, one image per page, in the order you added them.

faqs.q: Which image formats are supported?
faqs.a: JPG and PNG images can be converted into a PDF.

faqs.q: Are my images uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No. The PDF is built locally in your browser using pdf-lib — your images never leave your device.

tools.name: PDF to Excel
tools.title: PDF to Excel Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF into rows and columns in a spreadsheet, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up.
tools.heroValueProp: Pull tabular data out of a PDF and into a spreadsheet you can actually sort, filter, and calculate with.

faqs.q: Will tables convert perfectly?
faqs.a: The converter approximates table structure from text spacing and position — it works well for simple tables but won't perfectly reconstruct complex, merged-cell layouts.

faqs.q: What happens to pages with charts or scanned images?
faqs.a: Pages with little extractable text are embedded as images in the spreadsheet instead, so nothing is lost.

faqs.q: Is my PDF uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Extraction and spreadsheet-building both happen locally in your browser.

tools.name: Excel to PDF
tools.title: Excel to PDF Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Convert a spreadsheet's first sheet into a table PDF, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn a spreadsheet into a PDF you can send to anyone, whether or not they have Excel installed.

faqs.q: Which file types can I convert?
faqs.a: XLSX, XLS, and CSV files can all be converted into a table-layout PDF.

faqs.q: Are multiple sheets and cell formatting preserved?
faqs.a: This is a basic converter: only the first sheet is converted, laid out as a simple table. Cell colors, fonts, and multi-sheet workbooks are not preserved.

faqs.q: Is my spreadsheet uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No. It's read and converted entirely in your browser.

tools.name: Sign PDF
tools.title: Sign PDF Online Free — Add Your Signature | EazyPDF
tools.description: Draw a signature and place it anywhere on a PDF page, free and browser-based. No upload, no account.
tools.heroValueProp: Draw your signature with your mouse, finger, or stylus and drop it exactly where it needs to go on the document.

faqs.q: Is this a legally binding e-signature service?
faqs.a: No — this is a simple visual signature tool for adding a drawn signature to a document, not a certified e-signature platform with identity verification or audit trails.

faqs.q: Can I use a touchscreen or trackpad to sign?
faqs.a: Yes, the signature pad works with mouse, touchscreen, and stylus input.

faqs.q: Is my document uploaded to sign it?
faqs.a: No. The signature is drawn and placed onto the PDF entirely in your browser.

tools.name: Extract Images
tools.title: Extract Images from PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Save every page of a PDF as a standalone image, free and browser-based. Download all images as a ZIP.
tools.heroValueProp: Pull every page of a PDF out as its own image file — handy for reusing a diagram, photo, or scanned page elsewhere.

faqs.q: Does this extract embedded images or full pages?
faqs.a: Each full page is rendered as an image — this captures everything visible on the page, not just embedded photos within it.

faqs.q: What format are the extracted images?
faqs.a: Images are exported as PNG files, bundled into a ZIP for download.

faqs.q: Is my PDF uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No. Pages are rendered to images locally using pdf.js.

tools.name: Compare PDFs
tools.title: Compare Two PDF Files Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Spot text differences between two PDF files, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up.
tools.heroValueProp: Find out what actually changed between two versions of a document without reading both side by side line by line.

faqs.q: Does this compare formatting or just text?
faqs.a: The comparison is based on extracted text content — it highlights text differences between the two files, not visual/formatting changes.

faqs.q: Are both files uploaded to a server to compare them?
faqs.a: No. Both PDFs are read and compared entirely in your browser.

faqs.q: Can I compare scanned PDFs?
faqs.a: Only if the scan has an extractable text layer (e.g. it was OCR'd). Pure image scans with no embedded text can't be text-compared.

tools.name: Reorder Pages
tools.title: Reorder PDF Pages Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Rearrange the pages of a PDF into any order you like, free and browser-based. Drag to reorder.
tools.heroValueProp: Drag pages into the exact order you need — no need to delete and re-merge, just rearrange what's already there.

faqs.q: How do I change the page order?
faqs.a: Drag each page's thumbnail into the position you want before saving the reordered file.

faqs.q: Can I remove pages while reordering?
faqs.a: Reorder Pages keeps every page — use Delete Pages or Organize PDF if you also need to drop some pages while rearranging.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No. Reordering happens locally using pdf-lib.

tools.name: Add Blank Page
tools.title: Add Blank Page to PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Insert a blank page anywhere in a PDF document, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Insert a blank page exactly where you need one — a separator, a spot for a printed signature, or just extra room.

faqs.q: Can I choose where the blank page goes?
faqs.a: Yes, you choose the exact position in the document where the new blank page is inserted.

faqs.q: Does the blank page match the size of the original pages?
faqs.a: Yes, the inserted page matches the surrounding page dimensions.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, this runs entirely in your browser using pdf-lib.

tools.name: Add Header & Footer
tools.title: Add Header and Footer to PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Add a running header and footer to every page of a PDF, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Stamp the same header and footer text across every page — a title, a date, a company name — without touching each page individually.

faqs.q: Can I set different text for the header and footer?
faqs.a: Yes, header and footer text are set independently.

faqs.q: Does it apply to every page automatically?
faqs.a: Yes, the same header/footer text is stamped onto every page of the document in one step.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No, this runs locally using pdf-lib.

tools.name: Invert PDF Colors
tools.title: Invert PDF Colors Free Online — Dark Mode PDF | EazyPDF
tools.description: Flip every page of a PDF to a negative / dark-mode style palette, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Flip a bright white PDF into a dark-background version that's easier on the eyes for night reading.

faqs.q: Will this make my PDF look like dark mode?
faqs.a: It inverts every page's colors into a negative palette, which gives a dark-background effect similar to dark mode, though results vary by document.

faqs.q: Does this work well on text-heavy documents?
faqs.a: It works best on simple text documents. Documents with photos or colored graphics will also have those colors inverted, which may look unusual.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, color inversion happens locally in your browser.

tools.name: Flatten PDF
tools.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Lock PDF form fields permanently into the page content, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Lock a filled-in form so the answers become part of the page itself and can no longer be edited or accidentally changed.

faqs.q: What does flattening actually do?
faqs.a: It converts any fillable form fields into permanent, non-editable page content — the visible values stay, but they can no longer be typed into or changed.

faqs.q: Should I flatten before or after filling a form?
faqs.a: Flatten after filling the form (see Fill PDF Form) once you're ready to lock the answers in.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, flattening happens locally using pdf-lib.

tools.name: Repair PDF
tools.title: Repair Corrupted PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Attempt to fix minor structural issues in a damaged PDF file, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Re-save a PDF that won't open properly elsewhere, rebuilding its internal structure from what can still be read.

faqs.q: What kinds of damage can this fix?
faqs.a: It can often recover PDFs with minor structural corruption by re-parsing and re-saving the document. Severely corrupted or truncated files may not be recoverable.

faqs.q: Is there a guarantee my file will be fixed?
faqs.a: No tool can guarantee recovery of every damaged file — if the underlying data is lost, repair can't restore it.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, the repair attempt happens entirely in your browser.

tools.name: PDF Metadata Editor
tools.title: Edit PDF Metadata Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Edit the title, author, and subject of a PDF file, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Change what shows up as the document's title, author, and subject in file properties and search results.

faqs.q: What metadata fields can I edit?
faqs.a: Title, author, and subject are the fields exposed for editing.

faqs.q: Why would I want to change this?
faqs.a: Correct metadata makes a document easier to find and identify later, and looks more professional when shared or archived.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, metadata is edited locally using pdf-lib.

tools.name: PDF Page Size Converter
tools.title: Change PDF Page Size Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Change a PDF's page dimensions to a standard size like A4 or Letter, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Resize every page in a PDF to a standard size like A4 or Letter — useful when a document needs to print correctly in a different region.

faqs.q: Which page sizes are supported?
faqs.a: Standard sizes such as A4 and Letter are supported as conversion targets.

faqs.q: Will content be stretched or cropped?
faqs.a: Page content is scaled to fit the new page dimensions as closely as possible while preserving the original layout.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, this runs locally in your browser.

tools.name: Fill PDF Form
tools.title: Fill PDF Form Online Free | EazyPDF
tools.description: Fill out fillable form fields in a PDF and save the result, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Type directly into a PDF's existing form fields and save a completed copy — no printing, filling by hand, and rescanning.

faqs.q: Does this work on any PDF?
faqs.a: It works on PDFs that already contain fillable AcroForm fields. A plain scanned document with no form fields can't be filled this way.

faqs.q: Can I lock the answers in afterward?
faqs.a: Yes, use Flatten PDF after filling to make the entered values permanent and non-editable.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, the form is filled entirely in your browser.

tools.name: HTML to PDF
tools.title: HTML/Text to PDF Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Turn plain text or simple HTML into a formatted PDF document, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn plain text or basic HTML content into a clean, formatted PDF document.

faqs.q: What kind of HTML is supported?
faqs.a: Basic text and simple formatting — this is not a full browser rendering engine, so complex layouts, CSS, and scripts won't be reproduced.

faqs.q: Can I convert plain text instead of HTML?
faqs.a: Yes, plain text is also accepted and laid out as a formatted PDF.

faqs.q: Is my content uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, the PDF is built entirely in your browser.

tools.name: PDF to TXT
tools.title: PDF to TXT Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Extract all readable text from a PDF into a plain .txt file, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Pull just the raw text out of a PDF — useful for pasting into another document, an AI tool, or a plain-text editor.

faqs.q: Does this preserve formatting?
faqs.a: No, the output is plain text with no fonts, layout, or images — just the readable text content.

faqs.q: Will this work on scanned PDFs?
faqs.a: Only if the scan already has a text layer (e.g. from OCR). A pure image scan has no extractable text.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, text is extracted locally using pdf.js.

tools.name: TXT to PDF
tools.title: TXT to PDF Converter Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Turn plain text into a formatted PDF document, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Type or paste plain text and turn it into a clean, paginated PDF document in one step.

faqs.q: Do I need to upload a .txt file?
faqs.a: No, you can type or paste text directly into the tool — there's no file upload step required.

faqs.q: Does long text automatically split across pages?
faqs.a: Yes, text that doesn't fit on one page automatically flows onto additional pages.

faqs.q: Is my text sent anywhere?
faqs.a: No, the PDF is generated entirely in your browser.

tools.name: Image Compressor
tools.title: Image Compressor Free Online — Shrink to Exact KB | EazyPDF
tools.description: Shrink an image down to an exact KB target, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Shrink a photo down to a specific file size — useful when a form or upload has a strict size limit.

faqs.q: Can I set an exact target file size?
faqs.a: Yes, enter a target size in KB and the tool compresses toward that target.

faqs.q: Which image formats are supported?
faqs.a: Common formats like JPG and PNG are supported.

faqs.q: Is my image uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, compression happens locally in your browser.

tools.name: Resize Image
tools.title: Resize Image Free Online — Exact Width & Height | EazyPDF
tools.description: Resize an image to exact width and height, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Resize a photo to exact pixel dimensions — for a profile picture, a form upload, or a specific layout requirement.

faqs.q: Can I set exact pixel dimensions?
faqs.a: Yes, enter the exact width and height you need in pixels.

faqs.q: Will the image be stretched if the aspect ratio changes?
faqs.a: If your target dimensions don't match the original aspect ratio, the image will stretch to fill them.

faqs.q: Is my image uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, resizing happens locally in your browser.

tools.name: Crop Image
tools.title: Crop Image Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Crop an image to a precise pixel region, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Trim an image down to just the part you need, with precise control over the crop area.

faqs.q: How precise is the crop selection?
faqs.a: You can draw and adjust the crop box directly on the image before applying it.

faqs.q: Which image formats are supported?
faqs.a: Common formats like JPG and PNG are supported.

faqs.q: Is my image uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, cropping happens locally in your browser.

tools.name: Convert Image Format
tools.title: Convert Image Format Free Online — PNG, JPG, WebP | EazyPDF
tools.description: Convert an image between PNG, JPG, and WebP formats, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Convert between PNG, JPG, and WebP — for compatibility, smaller file size, or whatever format a site or app requires.

faqs.q: Which formats can I convert between?
faqs.a: PNG, JPG, and WebP are all supported as both source and target formats.

faqs.q: Does converting to JPG lose transparency?
faqs.a: Yes, JPG doesn't support transparency — converting a transparent PNG to JPG will fill the transparent areas with a solid background.

faqs.q: Is my image uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, conversion happens locally in your browser.

tools.name: Add Watermark to Image
tools.title: Add Watermark to Image Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Overlay custom watermark text on an image, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Stamp your own text watermark across a photo — useful for marking ownership before sharing it publicly.

faqs.q: Can I customize the watermark text?
faqs.a: Yes, you set the exact text used for the watermark.

faqs.q: Which image formats are supported?
faqs.a: Common formats like JPG and PNG are supported.

faqs.q: Is my image uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, the watermark is applied locally in your browser.

tools.name: Invert Image Colors
tools.title: Invert Image Colors Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Flip an image's colors to a negative palette, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Flip a photo's colors into a negative palette — a quick creative effect or a way to check contrast.

faqs.q: What does color inversion do exactly?
faqs.a: It flips every pixel's color to its negative — light areas become dark and colors shift to their opposites.

faqs.q: Which image formats are supported?
faqs.a: Common formats like JPG and PNG are supported.

faqs.q: Is my image uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, inversion happens locally in your browser.
